trigger: Founder supplied screenshot showing the platform had already reached maximum conversation length while the assistant response asserted the current chat remained the working chat.
finding: The rule itself allowed for a platform hard limit, but the assistant improperly reported the current chat as still usable without evidence of the external UI state. The screenshot shows the exception was already active.
corrections: Separate Legacy chat-continuity governance from actual ChatGPT UI availability.
Never use Python/GitHub validation to assert an external UI state.
When a platform maximum-length banner is evidenced, state that the platform—not the Founder and not the Legacy control—forced the chat boundary.
Carry all recoverable Legacy controls, work, Mirror Reviews, visuals, authority states, and source lineage across that forced boundary automatically.
